meta.title: Dictably — Meeting minutes you can click to hear
meta.description: Upload any call or meeting recording. Get a speaker-separated transcript and minutes with agreements and tasks linked to the exact second.

hero.h1: Meeting minutes you can click to hear.
hero.sub: Upload a call or meeting recording. Get the transcript and the minutes — what each side agreed to, linked to the exact second.
hero.under: We'll process one of your real recordings for free. No bot in your call. Any language.

problem.line1: After a 40-minute call, someone spends an hour writing the minutes.
problem.line2: A week later, nobody agrees on who promised what.
problem.line3: And finding where it was said means scrubbing through the recording again.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Zoom, Meet or Teams export, a phone call, a voice recorder on the table — audio or video, up to 3 hours. Nothing joins your meeting.
how.step2Body: Any language, including mixed-language calls. Rename "Speaker 2" to "Olena, Ministry" once.
how.step3Body: Decisions, agreements and tasks — split by side, with owners and deadlines when they were said. Click any point to hear that moment. Export to DOCX and send.

why.title: Why Dictably
why.item1Body: Each agreement links to the moment it was said. No more "we never agreed to that".
why.item2Body: See what you promised and what they promised — the way minutes are actually used.
why.item3Body: Strong on European languages — English, Ukrainian, Polish, German, Spanish and more — and on calls that switch between them.
why.item4Body: Works with any file, including offline meetings and phone calls.
why.item5Body: Recordings auto-delete after 30 days. Never used to train models.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.proBody: {hours} hours, minutes for every recording, DOCX / SRT / TXT export.
pricing.foundingBody: First {seats} people. Price stays while you stay subscribed.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Around 100. Best quality in English and major European languages, including Ukrainian and Polish. Mixed-language calls are supported.
faq.q2: How long can a recording be?
faq.a2: Up to 3 hours or 2 GB per file. Audio and video: mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, mov and more.
faq.q3: Do I need a bot in Zoom/Teams?
faq.a3: No. Upload the recording after the meeting — or record right in the browser (coming soon).
faq.a4: Only you. Files are encrypted, deleted after 30 days (or sooner, by you), and never used for training.
faq.q5: Is it legal to record meetings?
faq.a5: Rules differ by country — always tell participants you are recording.
faq.a6: Early access starts with founding members. Leave your email and we'll process one of your recordings for free.

final.h2: Stop rewriting meetings. Start sending minutes.
final.under: Free minutes from one of your real recordings.

privacy.title: Privacy — early access · Dictably
privacy.metaDescription: What Dictably collects during early access: forms, analytics, and recordings you send for free minutes.
privacy.intro: Dictably is in early access. This page explains what we collect right now.
privacy.collectBody:
Early-access form: your email and the answers you choose to give. The form is hosted by Tally.

Site analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics — no cookies, no cross-site tracking, aggregated visits only.

Recordings you send us for free minutes: the audio or video file, the transcript and the minutes we make from it.
privacy.processBody: We transcribe them with AssemblyAI and generate the minutes with Anthropic's Claude. Both process the data on our behalf and do not use it to train their models. Files are stored privately and deleted within 30 days, or sooner if you ask. Please send only recordings whose participants know they are being recorded.
privacy.dontBody: We don't sell your data, don't show ads and don't share your recordings with anyone else.
privacy.rightsBody: Ask us at any time to see, correct or delete your data: {email}. We reply within 30 days.
privacy.changesBody: When the product launches, this page will be replaced by a full privacy policy. Last updated: {date}.
